cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 200 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -20
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    pg=b.new_page()
    pg.goto("https://www.kaggle.com/docs/efficient-gpu-usage",wait_until="networkidle",timeout=90000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    t=pg.inner_text("body")
    import re
    for kw in ["30 hours","12 hours","quota","T4","P100","GPU"]:
        for m in re.finditer(kw,t,re.I):
            print(f"[{kw}]",t[max(0,m.start()-150):m.start()+200].replace("\n"," ")[:330]); break
    b.close()
